sparse_definition.sparse_candidate: graph support status != 'available' OR qualified_neighbours < K_SPARSE
sparse_definition.explanation_complete: all 7 Stage 9 faithfulness checks pass for that Top-5 row
sparse_definition.district_density_rule: keep the lowest-density districts until the slice would exceed 25% of the catalogue, computed before any condition is run
sparse_definition.type_rule: the two most frequent property types in the full catalogue, descending

analysis_plan.population: ranking-role queries that keep a Top-5 in both the condition and the reference
analysis_plan.excluded: queries that lose ranking eligibility are reported as affected queries, not scored
analysis_plan.comparison: each condition vs reference, paired on query_id
analysis_plan.multiplicity: Holm across all non-reference conditions in this run
analysis_plan.decision_rule: report a difference only when p_holm < 0.05

definitions.fallback_rate_pct: Top-5 rows whose graph support status is not 'available'
definitions.sparse_candidate_pct: Top-5 rows matching the frozen sparse-neighbour definition
definitions.mean_qualified_neighbours_top5: eligible neighbours available to each Top-5 candidate
definitions.ndcg5_rubric: graded NDCG@5 on the paired population, rubric REL-v1 (100% coverage)
definitions.top5_overlap_vs_available_reference: |Top-5(condition) ∩ Top-5(reference restricted to properties still in this catalogue)| / min(5, that size) - separates rank change from universe change
definitions.reference_top5_available_pct: share of the reference Top-5 that still exists in this condition's catalogue
definitions.queries_lost_ranking: queries ranked in the reference but below 5 eligible properties here
definitions.queries_lost_ranking_pct_of_reference: queries_lost_ranking / 135 reference ranking queries (not 250 frozen queries)
definitions.explanations_all_checks_passed_pct: denominator = Top-5 rows of the paired queries in this condition; numerator = rows where all 7 Stage 9 checks pass (evidence presence, score linkage, comparable linkage, ranking linkage, component coverage, fallback disclosure, location disclosure)
definitions.explanations_with_comparable_evidence_pc: denominator = Top-5 rows; numerator = rows whose retained neighbour list (graph_support.neighbours) is non-empty
definitions.missing_comparables_disclosed_pct: denominator = rows with an empty neighbour list; numerator = those rows whose generated explanation contains the accepted claim that discloses graph_support_unavailable
definitions.comparable_neighbour_validity_mean: per row, displayed comparable claims whose neighbour_id is in the shown neighbour set / all displayed comparable claims; 1.0 when no comparable claim was displayed
definitions.fallback_disclosure_accuracy_mean: per row, required disclosures present / required disclosures; 1.0 when nothing is required to be disclosed
definitions.evidence_coverage_mean: per row, explanation blocks referenced by an accepted claim / blocks available in that evidence record
definitions.graph_unavailable_disclosure_shown_pct: denominator = rows where graph_support_unavailable is required; numerator = rows that emit it
definitions.mean_claims_withheld: mean number of generated claims rejected by the Stage 9 validator per Top-5 row
